description: Hi! We are Project NOAH - Navigation, Orbit, Astronomy, Horizon from The Winchester School - Jebel Ali! We are participating in the NASA Hackathon to create an exciting Space Mission Design Game. We welcome individuals passionate about mathematics, science, astronomy, coding, and technology. If you love exploring space solving problems and sharing creative ideas we would love to have you on our team. Together let's innovate and reach beyond the stars!
